claims.assertion: Yazhi says frequency pods raise a person’s vibration to break compatibility with astral entities; lasting removal requires inner work.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Entities may return without sustained change.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says personal frequency affects which extraterrestrial species or star people a human may contact.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says it affects compatibility and the likelihood of communication.

claims.assertion: Yazhi rejects a literal solid dome over Earth and identifies the Van Allen belts as its closest physical analogue.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She claims the Moon enhances them by altering magnetosphere frequencies and describes a separate psychological dome.
